title: PREMARKET LIVE: The Trading Floor | Sector Rotation and Stocks to Watch
speaker: Arete Trading host (Rocky)

macro_themes.view: The whole September drop was tied to crude; if crude keeps falling the market goes higher.
Market is trending with island continuations instead of reversals; no sign of a big sell-off.
Brazil (EWZ) is an underappreciated binary event; leaning toward the conservative candidate winning.
Strong UMC September sales bode well for TSMC's numbers on Thursday; Asian markets benefit if oil falls.

calls.reason: Trending market grinding higher; the only thing holding it back was oil, which is now easing as tankers route around Iran.
calls.quote: it's my belief you're in a trending market. The only thing that's really been holding the market back has been oil.

calls.reason: Expects some bouncing around and maybe a dip, but no massive sell-off; QQQ rejected the new call wall while the put wall was raised.
calls.quote: do I see this massive sell-off? Not not like I thought I was going to see yesterday.

calls.reason: Crude peaked mid-September; shipping is working around Iran, so he sees the oil spike as over unless a new macro event hits.
calls.quote: I don't know how you're going to look at a crude oil chart right now and think it's going, you know, higher.

calls.reason: Accumulation (more buying days than selling days), capacity demand and strong news; Taiwan benefits from falling oil. Started buying the day before.
calls.quote: TSM I like a lot. I started picking at it yesterday.

calls.reason: Breadth of the semiconductor index looks fantastic, though 600 is an enormous call wall overhead.
calls.quote: the socks is at that 600 and that's an enormous call wall... but the breath of the socks looks freaking fantastic.

calls.reason: Range-bound between 1700 and 1800 with put wall at 1650; owns it and expects it to take time (maybe another earnings) as NAND prices keep rising.
calls.quote: you're really wedged in between 1,800 and 17, you know, 1700 in my opinion... I like SanDisk.

calls.condition: If trading it, premise is it won't break 160; upside to 220.
calls.reason: Support held despite heavy selling; would trade it with 160 as the line and 220 as target, but dislikes the CEO and sees better uses of capital.
calls.quote: if I was to trade this, it'd be like with the premise of I'm not going to break 160 and maybe I can get up …

calls.condition: Over 24 and holding 23.25, after the convertible prices.
calls.reason: September sales far above estimates; expects gap fill, then a cup-and-handle grind that takes out the highs once the convertible offering is priced.
calls.quote: as long as I don't break, you know, 23 and a quarter, you're probably okay there... you probably take out the highs.

calls.reason: Acting fantastic since blowout earnings, trending; sold near 505 on rebalance worries, may rebuy on a pullback.
calls.quote: it looks to me like you're heading right for those devil horns. You're probably getting back to that 550.

calls.reason: Thinks utilities probably bottomed; bought Southern Company and Duke and will sit with them.
calls.quote: XLU probably bottomed... I bought Southern Company. Um I bought Duke

calls.condition: Binary on the Brazil election; thinks the conservative candidate wins.
calls.reason: International money flowing into the real ahead of the election; gubernatorial/mayor results suggest the change happens.
calls.quote: I think it's going to work... I'm leaning that way with this... something that I'm probably going to, you know, get involved with.

calls.reason: Good news and Terafab shared with SpaceX; sees the companies converging, though he dislikes the robotaxi story.
calls.quote: if I look at something like Tesla, I think you're moving on.

calls.reason: Riding under a big downtrend line; wait for a breakout confirmed by RSI/MACD first.
calls.quote: I wouldn't be in a hurry. I'd wait and see like make sure that they hold
